list: the official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (names, descriptions, grades). Guides are original, written for this entry.

sources.label: KeenGamer
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap – All 55 Trophies

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. There are no online trophies and no difficulty-related trophies, and one playthrough is enough. Work the roadmap in order: finish the story first, then the 100% completion checklist, then the stragglers. PushSquare puts the whole hunt at 300 hours or more; KeenGamer estimates about 200.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first thing the story asks of you and it cannot be missed. Play it through and the trophy pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing
Reach the end of the mission

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Just play the story — the trophy unlocks when the chapter's last mission ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude; it is the one thing in the whole list that can be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Do the balcony meditation before the chapter ends

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it unlocks automatically when the chapter ends — no side work is needed for it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. It pops on its own when the chapter's story is done, so keep playing and it will come to you.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy — finish the chapter and it unlocks, leaving only the final mission between you and the story's end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Once it pops you can keep exploring Leonida in free roam for as long as you like, so nothing is locked behind the credits — the real cleanup work starts after this one.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Keep playing in free roam afterwards

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the story, so just keep playing the campaign and it will pop when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy — play the campaign until the heist is done and it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It comes with the story, so there is nothing to prepare — finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Another story trophy that unlocks when the mission ends — just keep working through the campaign.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The airport takedown is a story beat, so the trophy pops when the mission is done.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission story trophies — finish the operation and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy on the list. The in-game checklist opens after the story (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion). You do not have to do literally everything: 15 of 18 card sets, 300 of 397 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges are enough, but the full list still runs to dozens of robberies, collectibles and activities, so expect this one to take the longest by far.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to open the 100% checklist
Work the checklist: robberies, collectibles, activities
Check Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion as you go

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 in total — 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — so you only need a little over half. Stunt spots show on the map (Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots) and your total sits under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Find stunt spots on the map
Complete any mix of jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. One try at each is enough — no wins are needed — so dip into fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt, and the trophy pops after the ninth.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try one of each of the 9 activity types
No win is required, just one attempt each

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Two ranges host them: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero (find them under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges). Most challenges have three difficulty tiers and some stay locked until you meet their conditions — work through them tier by tier and track them in the same menu.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit both ranges: Rodgers Ranch (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin (Balsero)
Earn gold in every challenge across all tiers
Check Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges for progress

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Some races charge an entry fee, so bring cash. All locations show under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone locations

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replaying the same race does not count. Race spots appear as you explore; track them under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Racing. Most spots let you hire a car, and your own car's Rating can be raised with Mod Shop upgrades.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Use hired cars or upgrade your own at Mod Shops

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fairly early on, Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg — fish the marked area from a boat with a rod until you land one big enough. Any boat in the area works if you do not own one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Take Cal's request to catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg
Fish the marked area from a boat
Land one over 2 kg to beat him

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — any single game, start to finish. Arcade machines are scattered around Leonida; pick the shortest game you find and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Complete one arcade game from start to finish

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through every mission in Andy's strand and the trophy pops at the end of the last one — side strands like this can be finished after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand ends with the mission Maritime Disputes — finish it and the trophy is yours. Like the other character strands, it can wait until after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand ends with the mission Hometown Heroes — finish that one and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some side questlines count toward the eight, and the exact qualifying set is still being confirmed — work through every stranger strand you find and the trophy lands once eight qualifying ones are done. None of them are missable, and they can all be finished after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find stranger mission strands across Leonida
Finish them after the story if you like

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand runs through his wish-list vehicles — the guide lists where each one is, so grab each vehicle as it is requested and finish the strand to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Deliver each wish-list vehicle as requested

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand runs through the Kitty Litter Lab locations — follow the strand, clear the labs as they come up, and finish his last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Clear the Kitty Litter Lab locations

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and do the Chapter 1 one before you leave Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. A meditation only counts once its final zen animation has played. Track them under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations, and find discovered spots on the map under Exploration, then Meditate Around Leonida. This is the one trophy the guides flag as potentially missable, so make a manual save at the start of Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: After Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony in Chapter 1
Meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida
Wait for the final zen animation at each spot

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks for one specific animal — follow his strand, track the animal down, and take it. His strand also feeds the 100% checklist, which wants all 15 of his Target Deck objectives.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Hunt the unique animal he marks

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game; you need every card in any 3 of them. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. Cards you sell at pawn shops still count, and the 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this one lands on the way to the platinum.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Cards sold at pawn shops still count

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Hold Up to open the app on Jason's or Lucia's phone and scan landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags — 100 successful scans in total. Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in the game and 70 count toward 100%, so aim past 50 while you play — they are skill-based in-game achievements, and you can see them all under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build your wanted level to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and get clear of the search area — the trophy pops once the heat is off.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Break line of sight and escape the search area

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Chain three shop robberies in a row while keeping the same wanted level — do not let it clear between shops, and keep moving so the cops never catch up.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Keep the same wanted level through all three

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Getting inside a vehicle or scanning it with WAiNK discovers it, and the trophy should happen naturally through the story. Check your total under Progress, then Vehicles — the 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles, so keep scanning past this one.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Get inside or scan new vehicles with WAiNK

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a firefight with at least five enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends — tight cover and a fast weapon help.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a firefight with 5+ enemies close together

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and get it airborne — the trophy is about leaving on your own schedule, not the airport's.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Grab a Rhino and put it to work — the trophy wants the tank fought with, not just driven, so take it into a fight once you have it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you — and get out clean. Plan the approach, move fast, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The vaults open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4; there are 8 vaults in total and 100% wants all of them, so this trophy lands on the way to the platinum.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and the mission That's Where The Money Is…

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, take its cash, and lose the cops — a fast getaway car makes the escape part simple, so have one parked nearby before you strike.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the road

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover the whole map — all 52 areas, every region and road — until it is fully uncovered. It comes naturally if you drive everywhere during the story and the cleanup, so just keep exploring and it will pop.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Drive through every region of Leonida

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs in Leonida; hit one illegal operation for each of them. The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations, so keep going past this trophy once it pops.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find illegal operations on the map
Rob one for each of the 9 gangs

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar spot on Ocean Beach with a view and order a cocktail. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guides, so try the obvious beachfront bars first — it should pop once the drink and the view line up.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Find a bar with a view

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight out through the showroom front — the exact method is still unconfirmed, so pick a showroom with a big glass front and floor it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Drive a car out through the front

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal the three key valuables at the alley and escape. The alley is a set piece — grab all three items before leaving, then get out clean.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia — train it up for each of them until it is maxed, and the trophy pops once both are at the top.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the count builds up across robberies, crimes and story choices, so it lands naturally over a full playthrough without any special grind.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play through the story and side content
Let Criminal Profile actions accumulate to 500

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The unlock method for this hidden trophy is still unconfirmed — the name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, so it will likely pop on its own during a normal playthrough. Do not chase it until the guides confirm the trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Watch for it to pop on a second attempt

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy whose method is still unconfirmed — it is tied to witnessing something strange in Leonida, so it will likely pop while you are out exploring. Treat it as a wait-and-see until the guides confirm the trigger.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed — a melee attack from a moving vehicle at a target. Try it in traffic and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Perform a melee drive-by on a target

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Fence marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is laundered in total. The same total counts toward 100%, so it comes on the way to the platinum.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and anything else — the total is cumulative across every shop, and you will spend most of it naturally over a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 purchasable garages — buy every one. Save up during the story and buy them as you go, or clean them up after the finale with your heist money.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app to register 10 different vehicles you own or find — each registration counts once, so work through your collection.
trophies.name: On the Spot
